newsitem.title: CHINA: China's flag flies at HK international airport.
newsitem.headline: China's flag flies at HK international airport.

text.p: The red flag of Communist China flew over Hong Kong's international airport just minutes after Beijing assumed control over the former British colony on Tuesday.
"It's a strange feeling. I feel anxious. Yet I have hope for the future," Loretta Lo, in charge of VIPs at the airport, told Reuters.
Twenty enthusiastic local ground staff performed the simple flag-changing ceremony in a festive mood, stopping to pose and take snapshots of themselves.
The last contingent of Britain's Black Watch regiment, which lowered the British flag in border regions, will leave from the airport later in the morning.
